verdict.rationale: Phaser's pricing page says games built with a paid tool keep working because they are not linked to the licence, and a runtime probe shows the core engine is published on npm under MIT. Together these mean shipped games are not exposed to licence repricing. However, nothing in the pack documents a historical track record of stable pricing or terms, or any explicit commitment against retroactive changes. Missing for 10: documented history of pricing and licence stability, an explicit no-retroactive-change policy, independent or community corroboration of stable terms.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the pricing and license terms have a track record of stability — no retroactive changes that reprice games already shipped

citations.quote: any games you created will still work — they are not linked to the licence.
